Strategy: Hybrid band-and-pairing preference. Exact fits score highest; bins that can still hold another item of this size form the next tier, ranked tightest first; tight fits follow, while residuals between half and the full item score lowest. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit is awkward or cannot pair while a roomier bin can. It may help by combining pairing preservation with awkward-gap avoidance, but may fail if the preserved room is never reused.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (500.0 - (r - item) if r - item >= item else (-(r - item) - 200.0 if r - item > item / 2 else -(r - item))) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Hybrid band-and-pairing: exact > double-capable (tightest first) > tight > awkward band.
